raw_posts.name: beacon.sh
raw_posts.tagline: Open-source self-improving memory for AI coding agents
raw_posts.description: Beacon turns agent sessions across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, and 20+ other harnesses into a compounding knowledge layer, so every agent starts smarter than the last. It captures every agent trace across your environment and turns activity into clear operational visibility. Get started for free at beacon.sh

raw_posts.name: UnleashX
raw_posts.tagline: The AI workforce that turns conversations into outcomes.
raw_posts.description: UnleashX lets you hire AI employees like people - pick a role, connect your CRM and tools, set your rules, and hand over the work. Execute workflows end-to-end, with humans stepping in only when needed.

raw_posts.name: Xmind 2027
raw_posts.tagline: Your mind map is now an AI thinking partner
raw_posts.description: As information becomes easier to access, understanding and judgment matter more than ever. Xmind 2027 gives you and AI a shared visual space to work through ideas. With Xmind Agent, use your local documents and maps to research, develop ideas, and weigh possibilities through conversation. Your map evolves with your thinking. With MCP, bring that same context into ChatGPT, Claude, and your existing AI workflow, while you stay in control of the direction.

raw_posts.name: Cedric AI for Meetings
raw_posts.tagline: The first AI agent to present your slides and attend for you
raw_posts.description: Send Cedric to your Zoom, Meet, or Teams calls. He presents your slides, and answers questions using live data from your tools. Join late? He catches you up. Can’t join? He represents you. Afterwards, approve the notes and follow-ups, and he handles the work.

raw_posts.name: Hera
raw_posts.description: Generate images, design, and animate on one canvas. Direct multiple AI agents at the same time. Stay in control with editable layers. Make ads, launch videos, and social posts in your own brand. Paste your website to get your brand kit. Write a few prompts and get dozens of on-brand ads side by side. Drop in any ad you like as a reference, fix details with feedback or by hand, then animate your best ones into motion ads. Resize to every format, all on the same board.

raw_posts.name: Clayzo
raw_posts.tagline: Create animations and motion design with your coding agent
raw_posts.description: Clayzo makes it incredibly easy for coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor to create web animations and motion graphics. Your agent writes it in code and reviews every frame; you export a video or play it live on your site. And it’s free!

raw_posts.name: Self-Growing Websites by Greta.sh
raw_posts.tagline: Build a website that can do its own SEO & AEO automatically
raw_posts.description: You built a website/app, so why is nobody visiting? Getting found on Google & AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity etc takes months of SEO & AEO. Self-Growing Websites fix that. Greta.sh finds what customers search for, writes pages that answer them, and gets you showing up on Google, ChatGPT & everywhere With the Greta.sh MCP, you can run it all from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor: just ask it to build, grow, publish or report. Don't just build a website anymore, build a customer magnet with Greta.sh!

raw_posts.name: Display 1.0
raw_posts.tagline: Create docs and apps with any agent, in one workspace
raw_posts.description: Create and collaborate on docs, prototypes and apps with your team. Store the files your agents make, organise knowledge work in Spaces and Folders, and turn it all into your internal knowledge base. Work with any agent and any plan, at a flat price.

raw_posts.name: Agent Inbox
raw_posts.tagline: Give your agent an email address, Slack and Telegram handle
raw_posts.description: Agent Inbox gives every AI agent its own email address, Slack handle and Telegram handle, all behind one API. Message your agent from wherever you already work, and it replies in the same thread. It works with Claude, Grok, OpenAI, Hermes and any other agent framework. No more glue code for each channel: your agent gets one inbox, and you get one place to reach it.

raw_posts.name: Hyperresearch
raw_posts.description: Hyperresearch does the research and shows the evidence. Ask a question, get a cited report; each cited claim is checked against its source, and all sources are kept in a searchable vault. On the DRACO benchmark, we are the world's number-one research agent. New: Answers MCP and API. Your agent calls ask and gets a short answer with word-for-word quotes, or a simple "not found" instead of a hallucination. We combine 4 AI search engines and 40+ other data sources for the widest and deepest access.
